inlines.v: SWORN, participle passive of swear. The officers of government are sworn to a faithful discharge of their duty. SWORN friends, is a phrase equivalent to determined, close or firm friends. I am sworn brother, sweet, To grim necessity. SWORN enemies, are determined or irreconcilable enemies.
